rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Makes it an unlawful antitrust violation for rental property owners to pay for or use a coordinator's services, for coordinators to facilitate rent-fixing agreements, for anyone to engage in parallel pricing coordination, or for any person to perform a coordinating function (algorithmic setting or recommending of rents, lease terms or occupancy using competitors' nonpublic information). Municipalities may not enact conflicting ordinances.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act; enforcement under sections 6 through 17 of P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-6 through 9-17).
rules.status_basis: Approved July 20, 2026; takes effect the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment.

exempt_if.name: excluded_facilities
exempt_if.text: Residential dwelling unit does not include inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, or detention or correctional facilities.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental residential dwelling units in New Jersey and to the owners and coordinators who set or recommend their rents.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care and detention facilities, and government setting rents through affordability controls.

precedence.text: A municipality shall be prohibited from enacting an ordinance that conflicts with this act.

rules.quoted_span: any person to perform a coordinating function.
